annotation.title_clean: Directive (EU) 2023/2661 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 22 November 2023 amending Directive 2010/40/EU on the framework for the deployment of Intelligent Transport Systems in the field of road transport and for interfaces with other modes of transport
annotation.title_en: Directive (EU) 2023/2661 amending Directive 2010/40/EU on the framework for the deployment of Intelligent Transport Systems in the field of road transport and for interfaces with other modes of transport
annotation.authors_or_issuer: European Parliament and Council of the European Union
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union
annotation.summary_en: EU directive amending the Intelligent Transport Systems Directive 2010/40/EU. It makes certain road traffic data and safety-related ITS services mandatory, strengthens cooperative ITS (C-ITS) and connected automated mobility specifications, creates the C-ITS security credential system, and adds emergency countermeasures, data protection rules and reporting duties.
key_provisions_or_claims: Member States must make specified road traffic, parking and safety data available and accessible via national access points by dates in Annex III.
Safety-related minimum universal traffic information service must be deployed by 31 December 2026.
Priority area IV covers C-ITS and cooperative, connected and automated mobility, including the EU C-ITS security credential management system.
Commission may adopt immediately applicable countermeasures when ITS service integrity is compromised.
Personal data must be anonymised or pseudonymised where feasible; transposition due 21 December 2025.
